description: Current property values of one node or object in a running game, as the engine reports them. Returns: class and each property's type and value.

node.description: Node path: '/root/Main/Player', 'Main/Player', or an unambiguous tail such as 'Player'

object_id.description: Object id from runtime_tree or runtime_inspect

session_id.description: Session from runtime_run. Required only when several games run.

name: runtime_inspect
